title: Can I MASTER Racing Kings Chess?
summary: Five online Racing Kings games vs ~1500-1700 humans: both sides start on ranks 1-2 with no pawns and race their kings to the 8th rank.
rules: No pawns. Both armies start on ranks 1-2.
Giving check is illegal (no move may put either king in check).
First king to reach rank 8 wins; if white reaches it first and black can also reach rank 8 on the very next move, it is a draw.
